unmatched_sample_mediation_bug.verdict: Division rate beating ABCB1 (44% vs 27%) DOES NOT HOLD on matched samples — it was an artifact of dividing b2(n=190) by b0(n=290). On common lines (n=131), ABCB1 beats dt+prolif overall (25.0% vs 10.6%) and wins 4/4 vinca/taxane/anthracycline efflux drugs, while division rate dominates S-phase/topoII agents (MTX 70%, etoposide 62%). Combined passenger conclusion (#21) still holds.

s19_turnover_audit.cell_types_correction: MOESM4 & MOESM5 contain 4 non-dividing primary human cell types (B cells, NK cells, Hepatocytes, Monocytes) + 1 mouse cell type (Mouse Neurons, where human-symbol MVP/PARP4/TEP1 are NaN), not 5 primary human cell types. Because all 4 human cell types are non-dividing, half-lives reflect pure proteolysis WITHOUT cell-division dilution.
s19_turnover_audit.verdict: PARP4 < TEP1 < MVP holds in 4/4 human cell types (8/8 replicates for MVP and PARP4), so abundance bias does NOT create the 3x gap (1.5x in hepatocytes to 8.1x in NK cells).

s15_crossspecies_orthology_audit.argon_self_correction_on_ACTR3: Claude is right on P42528 (ARP3_DICDI / GN=ARPC, log2FC = -0.588): Argon previously misread O96624 (ARPC3_DICDI / GN=ARCC, log2FC = +1.387) as Arp3/ACTR3 due to Dictyostelium's ARPC vs ARCC naming.

s16_coessentiality_pc_whitening_audit.verdict: Argon's H2a gate genuinely fails even after 10/30/50-PC Wainberg whitening; moreover, PC-whitening collapses MVP's max genome-wide r from 0.205 to 0.130, confirming the 2,886 raw q<0.05 hits were screen-PC artifacts.

s21_s22_tissue_audit.literature_agreement: Izquierdo et al. (Am J Pathol 1996, PMID: 8623910) monoclonal LRP-56 IHC survey explicitly identified adrenal cortex, GI tract epithelium, and bronchial epithelium as the highest-MVP normal human tissues. Bulk lung nTPM (#5) is diluted by ~70% alveolar endothelium/AT1 parenchyma.
